title: Console launch blueprint: comms scripts, role-based training, and handoff protocol for dashboards, rollouts & cost insights
creator: Priya Rao
description: This ticket captures the go-to-market blueprint for the Console UX feature set we are shipping in console-2026.03: new dashboards, rollout controls (canaries/A-B/automatic fallback), and the cost breakdown view. The deliverable is a single coordinated launch package that includes: tailored customer-facing release notes, internal comms scripts for Sales/Support/TPMs, role-based training playbooks (support runbooks, developer quickstarts, sales talking points), and a formal handoff protocol to Support and Customer Success. The goal is a predictable, low-friction activation for early-adopter customers and clear escalation paths for issues during the first 14 days post-launch.
goals: Ensure all customer-facing docs and release notes clearly explain behavior changes and migration steps
Prepare Sales and CS to articulate cost breakdown changes and optional controls (batching, caching, priority tiers)
Train Support on common troubleshooting steps and SLO degradation indicators
Define an internal communication cadence and runsheet for launch day and 14-day monitoring

deliverables: Customer-facing release notes (short + long) in HTML and plaintext
Support runbook with triage checklist and escalation matrix
Sales one-pager and email template with cost transparency talking points
Developer quickstart + migration checklist for teams pinning models or changing rollout policies
Training recordings and slides for Support, Sales, Solutions Engineering
Launch runsheet (minute-by-minute for first 48 hours) and on-call assignments
communication_plan: Week -2: Circulate feature brief to GTM leads (Sales, CS, Support, Tech PMs) and schedule training
Week -1: Publish knowledge base articles and staged in-app help content; Marketing drafts release announcement
Launch day (T0): Send launch email to opt-in customers; post short release note on status page; in-app banner with opt-in link for early access
T+1/T+7/T+14: Health summary emails to internal stakeholders with adoption metrics, error rates, and customer feedback highlights
launch_checklist: Confirm Legal sign-off on customer messaging (release notes + pricing language)
Merge and deploy console front-end changes behind feature flag
Enable staged rollout policy for initial region (us-west) and configure automatic fallback rules
Publish KB articles and link them from the in-app banner
Schedule 60-minute training for Support and record session
Prepare incident channel and assign on-call rotations for first 72 hours
Prepare metrics dashboard (latency, errors, per-route cost breakdown) with alert thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Release notes approved and published in product and knowledge base
Support runbook validated in a dry-run scenario and acknowledged by on-call leads
Sales has at least one recorded enablement session and signed off on talking points
Staged rollout successfully toggled in us-west with monitoring alerts firing under test conditions
No showstopper regressions in the 48-hour post-deploy smoke tests
risks: Customers misinterpret cost breakdowns and file pricing complaints — mitigated by clear examples and a FAQ
Rollout triggers unexpected latency due to KV cache warm-up — mitigation: simulated warm-up traffic and trace debugging plan
Support overwhelmed by novel failure modes — mitigation: runbook, extra triage staff for first week
Docs delayed causing inconsistent messaging — mitigation: freeze on messaging 48 hours before launch and escalate blockers
